test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 9 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The passage is mainly about:

options.text: The merging of Greek and Roman civilisations
The grandeur and fall of Troy
River Tiber, the lifeline of Rome
The founding of Rome and early influences

solution:
The correct answer is '**The founding of Rome and early influences**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The passage talks in detail about how the city of Rome was founded and mentions several legends and myths regarding how the city got its name. 
 
• The latter half of the passage points out the influences of other civilizations like the Greeks and Etruscans. The passage states that these civilizations influenced Roman culture, economy, and social life to a great degree. 
 
• Thus, the given passage talks about all the myths and legends associated with the founding of Rome and how other civilizations influenced the city and its people. 
 
• This makes option 4 the correct answer.
